name: PM Street Vendor's AtmaNirbhar Nidhi
description: Central sector micro-credit scheme providing working capital loans to street vendors to build business credit, modernized with higher tranches and credit cards through 2030.
ministry: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
target_beneficiaries: Hawkers and mobile food/goods sellers in statutory and peri-urban areas
benefits: Collateral-free working capital credit: 1st tranche up to Rs. 15,000, 2nd tranche up to Rs. 25,000, 3rd tranche up to Rs. 50,000, with 7% interest subsidy, monthly digital cashback, and UPI-linked RuPay credit card up to Rs. 30,000 upon timely 2nd loan repayment.

source_evidence.statement: Administered by the Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs (MoHUA), Government of India.
source_evidence.issuing_authority: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs

source_evidence.statement: Central sector micro-credit initiative accessible across urban and peri-urban jurisdictions nationwide.
source_evidence.issuing_authority: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs

source_evidence.statement: Street vendors engaged in vending in urban areas possessing vending certificate or identity card.
source_evidence.issuing_authority: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs

source_evidence.statement: Restructured tranches of Rs. 15,000, Rs. 25,000, and Rs. 50,000 with 7% interest subsidy and credit cards approved through March 2030.
Official portal and vendor loan application hosted on pmsvanidhi.mohua.gov.in.
source_evidence.issuing_authority: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs

source_evidence.statement: Operational disbursement update confirms active lending and interest subsidy credits across urban local bodies.

eligibility_criteria.limitations: Captures urban street vendor vending certificate/identification requirement as verified by MoHUA guidelines.

required_documents.title: Aadhaar Card
required_documents.description: UIDAI Aadhaar card for vendor identity verification.
required_documents.guidance: Mobile number must be linked with Aadhaar for application OTP verification.

required_documents.title: Certificate of Vending or Identity Card
required_documents.description: Certificate issued by Urban Local Body / Town Vending Committee.
required_documents.issuing_authority: Town Vending Committee / Urban Local Body
required_documents.guidance: Obtain from local municipal corporation or apply for LoR through PMSVANidhi portal.
